acceptanceCriteria: The Watch generates reference audio locally and never acts as an implicit remote playback trigger.
The companion exposes the approved profile, pitch, timbre, level, route, playback, and resume flow.
Profile data transferred to Watch is versioned, atomic, and remains usable while the iPhone is unreachable.
Simulator logic tests and required physical-device Watch qualification remain clearly separated.
notes: Local independent Watch synthesis is fixed by JT-FR-046 and JT-FR-051; physical feasibility is a qualification concern, not an open architecture decision.
Implementation is recorded at the user's direction. Verification remains pending the user's simulator and physical-device qualification.
rationale: Watch platform constraints may materially change the intended companion interaction.
testSteps: Verify paired connectivity, stale data behavior, playback semantics, accessibility, and lifecycle transitions.

workItem.title: Deliver the Apple Watch companion experience
